description: Accounts in the hand of ʿArūs b. Yosef. Recto mentions: what Abū l-Faḍl is owed by Sitt Abū l-Surūr (two raṭls of lāsīn); silk; Ibn Saʿd; Ibn al-Dabbāgh al-Simsār; al-Shammāʿ; brazilwood; Ruzayn(?) al-Qammāḥ. Verso is headed "details of what is in the bundle of [...] ʿArūs, which went up/which I sent up in [...]." Mentions a turban; various numbers of fūṭas and mats and farkhas and malḥafas (for Hillel b. Ḥasan).
description_he: חשבונות, המזכירים שמות כגון אבו אל-פד'ל וסת אבו אל-סרור וסחורות כגון משי.
